items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: those guys sounded like Woody Herman or Maynard Ferguson, a Buddy Rich type band.

ctx.x: The University of Indiana has jazz, and Steven was mentioning about North Texas State. They played in some of George Wein's festivals, the number one band, you know, down in Austin, Texas, and those guys sounded like Woody Herman or Maynard Ferguson, a Buddy Rich type band. And just ten of those big twenty-piece jazz bands, all at one time, and the number one band on down, in those days, and I think the University of Nebraska has a big Ashford jazz course, that guy, Alexander, he was up there for awhile, did you…

So all these schools are training a lot of jazz people and then others -- I was just down in Dallas or Houston, a few years ago, to help judge these bands, some school bands. Max Kaminsky was down there, and Jimmy Owens, and quite a few professional players, and they had 30-piece jazz bands. They were using seven trumpets and six trombones,
